Indian sailor killed, others injured in Iran strike on UAE tankers

An Indian sailor has died and six others were injured following an Iranian missile strike on two United Arab Emirates-flagged tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The incident occurred in international waters. The family of the deceased sailor is mourning their loss.
